title: In This City, Your Price Is Written Above Your Head. Mine Says Zero.
description: Rich people live in the sky. Poor people live in their shadow. My price tag says zero… and that changed everything.

scenes.narration: In this city, everyone's price is written above their head. Mine says *zero*.
Up there, on the sky deck, they're worth *millions*. Down here, in their shadow, we're worth about twelve dollars.
The golden elevator reads your price. If it's high enough, the doors open. If not, the guards walk you home.
My best friend Mia is worth forty. She's been saving her whole life to reach a hundred.
Every morning she watches the elevator doors close in front of her, like a gate to a different planet.
I tried the elevator anyway. The scanner beeped, blinked, and showed an error. The guard laughed so hard he dropped his hat.
So I found the old ladder on pillar seven. Two hundred and thirty rungs. I counted every one.
Halfway up, a storm hit. My hands were shaking. I didn't look down.
At sunrise, I pushed open the hatch. Gardens. Pools. Golden houses. And *real* sunlight.
Then the guards saw me. Six of them. Running.
They grabbed my arm, read my price, and *froze*.
Because up here, there's one law above all others: anything with a price can be *bought*. Including guards.
And something with a price of zero... can't be bought. Can't be sold. Can't be *stopped*.
So I walked straight to the golden elevator. And this time, I pressed *down*.
Mia's price still says forty. But tonight, she's riding up with me. And nobody can stop us.
So what's the price above *your* head? Be honest in the comments.
